name: 进门-业绩点评
description_zh: 依赖进门 MCP 获取报告期相关资料，为单家上市公司的某一报告期生成“精简版”业绩点评报告。适用于用户给出“公司名称 + 报告期（+ 可选关注点）”，要求点评/解读/分析某公司某季报、半年报、年报、业绩预告/快报的业绩表现时。
description_en: Requires the Comein MCP to retrieve reporting-period materials and generates a concise earnings review for a listed company and a specified reporting period. Use it when the user provides a company name and reporting period, with an optional focus, and asks for an analysis of a quarterly, interim, or annual report, earnings preview, or preliminary earnings report.
